sources.title: Karnak 40B v1.0 (40B) — MMLU 80 | Deploy Guide & Hardware Fit ...
sources.snippet: Karnak 40B v1.0 is a large MoE model by Applied-Innovation-Center based on the Qwen3 architecture, featuring a 256K context window and support for Arabic and English to handle long documents and complex reasoning.

sources.title: Karnak-40B-v1.0 — VRAM, Quants & GPU Compatibility
sources.snippet: Karnak-40B-v1. by Applied-Innovation-Center — 40.67B parameter apache-2.0 model with 262K context. Minimum 27GB VRAM (Q4_K_M quantization). Compatible with 36 GPUs, cloud rental from $0.30/hr. 3 quantization options available.

sources.title: Karnak 40B v1.0 — Hardware Requirements & Compatibility
sources.snippet: Karnak 40B v1.0 — Hardware Requirements & GPU Compatibility Chat Karnak 40B v1.0 is a 40.7B-parameter open language model from Applied-Innovation-Center. It supports a context window of up to 262,144 tokens. At Q4_K_M it needs about 24.84 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below.
